## 🔍 Verifying Annotations

To confirm the quality of the pseudo-labeled segmentations, use the `visualize_labels.py` script:

```bash
python src/visualize_labels.py \
    --images ./dataset_ran_ado/train/images \
    --labels ./dataset_ran_ado/train/labels \
    --out ./verification_viz \
    --num 20
```

This will generate 20 random samples in `./verification_viz` with the segmentation polygons overlaid on the tiles. Inspect these images to ensure:
1. Polygons tightly fit the pollen grains.
2. The species classification is correct.
3. No significant background noise is being labeled.
